_note: Commodity groups for the Churn Explorer. Each OID item is 'Category: item' or a bare item. An item is assigned by its OID category first (category_map, case-insensitive substring), then by keywords in the item text (keyword groups, regex, case-insensitive, word-start anchored). An item can match several keyword groups. A spell belongs to every group any of its crops, livestock or wild-crops items match. Handling items are not classified. Order of 'groups' is the display order. Keywords are matched anywhere in the item text unless the pattern has \b. Ambiguous: bare 'beans'/'peas' -> Vegetables, 'dry beans' -> Grains; 'Other: Corn' -> Grains (field corn assumed); cotton and tobacco fall to Other. Keywords extended on 18 Nov 2026 after review of data/commodity_audit.csv (about 80 clearly identifiable items, e.g. pak choi, escarole, dandelion, marigold, kumquat).
